review: Read all five selected runtime modules and six suites, plus the unchanged scoped review boundary and shared guide content. This is a client source cohort; native provider, installer and shared contracts retain separate source/acceptance scopes.

Managed Discord voice is explicitly a private paid-sandbox check. It requires the exact approved task, installation and review revision, matching room scope, current invitation lease and duration. The UI caps duration to the shortest approval/lease/scope bound and ten minutes. Native/domain/worker consent and funding checks remain authoritative.

Runtime fix 41 uses the existing room/account review boundary around probe, binding, approval-body and native-call continuations. Six failures reproduced before the change: late binding or approval reads after room change, account change or unmount could reach native start. All now stop before invoking that path.

The PCM helper accepts complete bounded 48 kHz stereo PCM16 frames and wraps them in WAV. Its tests validate the result with the existing native WAV validator and reject incomplete/oversized segments; no real speech or transcription request was used.

Developer guidance copies only an explicit prompt or source URL and labels checkout-only tooling and unproven public import/action capability. Local package inspection requires explicit file selection, compares SHA-256 locally, and never uploads, extracts, installs or grants trust.

Reviewed connector import uses a separate fixed-review native prototype. It parses strict native state, waits for explicit import/remove, keeps installed code stopped, clears stale account/bridge results and preserves removal after review expiry. Unmount cancels only a pending mutation, not a read-only inspection.
Thirty-three mocked tests cover these paths. The actual inspection helper is mocked in UI tests; integrity/compatibility/native ordinary-account acceptance remains independently required.
limits: Unfrozen unpublished source proposal; fix 41 and earlier post-R380 changes remain uninstalled.
No microphone, Discord session, provider billing, audio playback, archive import, executable download or real native approval occurred.
Already accepted native/provider operations are not undone by client retirement. Outcome reconciliation, cost settlement, participant consent and real revocation require native/service receipts.
Neither a matching archive checksum nor the private fixed-review import establishes general community adapter admission, capability registration, program grants or runtime execution.

The web preview omits separately scoped native/shared contracts. Export tests use canonical unselected dependencies, including the native WAV validator. They are not a full installed application acceptance run.
Five intentional support-contact matches elsewhere remain for the exact public-candidate review.
